fallos_mitigaciones: Full-prompt rewrites/unstructured merges cause knowledge loss & semantic drift (S1/abstract; GEPA's discard-and-rewrite discards valuable supervision, degrades w/ GT hints, S5). Mitigated via code-based targeted field edits (only the relevant substring changes, safety filter intercepts out-of-scope ops before execution, S3.4) + Global Training Context (Auxiliary Context avoids local optima, Reflection History H prevents contradictory edits, S3.3). Open issue (App C.1): context length still grows across iterations; partially mitigated by capping additions/batch; periodic flushing-with-recovery and adaptive-frequency-reduction are PROPOSED future work, NOT implemented.
cita: Gangireddi et al. (2026). REVERE: Reflective Evolving Research Engineer for Scientific Workflows.
notes: S3.1-3.4: three editable fields F={Fs,Fx,Fc} (system/task prompt + cheatsheet); Reflector applies code-based (Python program) edits per batch, safety-filtered+isolated execution (ADMISION+ACTUALIZACION). S3.3 Global Training Context = Cheatsheet(PROCEDIMENTAL, reusable heuristics) + Reflection History H (EPISODICA log of past adaptation rationale/outcome) + Auxiliary Context. Table1: offline REVERE beats Static-SOTA on all 3 benchmarks (Overall 29.8 vs SOTA 24.5 hint-free SUPER; SAB SuccessRate 33.2 vs 27.8, CodeBERTScore -5.36 offset by SR gain). Table3 ablation: removing cheatsheet causes broadest degradation; removing whole GTC = largest drop (component interaction). Fig4C/footnote5: REVERE curation cost $0.16 USD vs ACE $0.47 USD on SUPER; abstract '10x more cost-effective adaptation' -> COSTO-TOKENS/MEDICION-COSTO. Abstract explicitly frames as 'global memory consolidation' -> CONSOLIDACION. Single unified Reflector (not multi-agent pipeline, S3.4) -> multiagente=NO. No retrieval/selective-read mechanism (fields fully injected each time) -> retrieval=NA, mide_lectura=NO. NEGATIVO sense(b): shows GEPA/ACE (esp. w/ gold hints) DEGRADE vs baseline (Table1), evidence memory/context-adaptation methods can fail. F confirms F_screening (NEGATIVO;CONSOLIDACION;PROCEDIMENTAL) + added COSTO (explicit $ cost decomposition Fig4C) + WRITE (core code-based field-update mechanism).

fallos_mitigaciones: Isolated single-stream Reflexion lacks selection pressure: instances can accumulate counterproductive artifacts that degrade performance below the zero-shot start, high-variance policies (S3.2). Mitigated by FORGE's population-based champion broadcast (replaces every non-champion instance's memory with the best-performing one, structurally providing selection). No-graduation ablation confirms broadcast (not graduation) carries the performance gain; graduation mainly saves compute (abstract, S5).
cita: Bogdanov et al. (2026). FORGE: Self-Evolving Agent Memory With No Weight Updates via Population Broadcast.
notes: S3.1: hierarchical ReAct agent (Planner/Analyst/ActionChooser sub-agents, hence multiagente=SI) with per-role dynamic memory M_i, representation in {Rules, Examples, Mixed} text artifacts, stored on disk, re-injected into system prompt (fixed capacity). S3.2 Algorithm1: failure-triggered Reflexion inner loop (per-step reward < tau=-1.1 aborts episode; Reflector/Exemplifier synthesizes a rule/example artifact, appended -> WRITE). S3.3 Algorithm2 outer loop: staged (S=6 stages) champion broadcast is explicitly 'a destructive operation: each recipient discards its own accumulated artifacts' and its memory is fully REPLACED by the champion's (ACTUALIZACION + OLVIDO of the losing memory) -> handoff=CONTENIDO (full memory state broadcast between instances). Graduation freezes strong solutions (theta=-15 episode return). Table3: FORGE improves 1.7-7.7x over zero-shot, 29-72% over Reflexion in all 12 model-representation conditions; reduces major-failure rate to ~1%. Table2/S4: explicit Token Cost metric (total prompt+completion tokens) + Rules ~40% fewer tokens than Examples at comparable returns -> COSTO-TOKENS. NEGATIVO sense(b): all 4 zero-shot LLM families show 'strongly negative, heavy-tailed' returns (abstract) = negative evidence baseline agents fail badly without memory. No retrieval mechanism (full memory always injected) -> retrieval=NA. F confirms F_screening (NEGATIVO;MULTIAGENTE;WRITE) + added COSTO (explicit Token-Cost metric, Table2/Fig4) + PROCEDIMENTAL (Rules=heuristics core representation).

fallos_mitigaciones: 'Cognitive recurrence': repair agents repeatedly attempt plausible-but-incorrect solutions (e.g. modifying the view layer for a state-logic bug) because failed attempts are treated as isolated trials, not reusable knowledge (S1/S3.2 Challenge3). Mitigated by injecting Negative Constraints + Golden Principles from the Failure Memory Bank's Cognitive Layer, which 'prunes high-probability failure branches early' (S4, Table2: +FailureMem memory-only ablation +2.3pp, largest single-component gain).
cita: Ma et al. (2026). FailureMem: A Failure-Aware Multimodal Framework for Autonomous Software Repair.
notes: S3.2 Failure Memory Bank B={M_i}: 3-layer entries per historical failure -- Contextual (Issue Summary + textual Visual Analysis, retrieval keys), Cognitive (Cognitive Diagnosis, Negative Constraint, Golden Principle -- abstract/transferable, PROCEDIMENTAL), Code (Failed vs Golden Patch Summaries, EPISODICA specific trace). Built OFFLINE by distilling (failed patch, gold patch, issue, screenshots) via Gemini-3-Pro into structured entries (CONSOLIDACION). Screenshots encoded as TEXT not stored raw ('reduces token cost during retrieval') -> mem_tipos excludes MULTIMODAL. Selector Agent does single-pass top-k selection over all candidate Contextual Layers given the new issue (semantic understanding, not embedding-index ranking) -> retrieval=RANKING. Table2 ablation: Base 28.6% -> +Active Perception 30.0% -> +Bash 30.2% -> +FailureMem(memory only) 30.9% -> Full 33.1% (+4.5pp cumulative); Table3 Component Analysis explicitly ablates WHICH memory fields are injected (Cognitive/Code/Failure) and measures Resolved Rate, directly measuring read-side utility -> mide_lectura=SI/RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO. Table1: GPT-5.1 FailureMem 33.1% vs GUIRepair 29.4% (+3.7%, matches abstract); consistent across GPT-4.1(+2.3%)/Claude4.5(+2.3%). Cost: '$0.33 per issue, a 13% rise compared to GUIRepair's $0.29' (S4, considered acceptable tradeoff) -> COSTO-TOKENS. NEGATIVO sense(a): memory bank explicitly stores FAILURES (Failed Patch Summary, Negative Constraint) as first-class content. F confirms F_screening (NEGATIVO;WRITE;RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO) + added CONSOLIDACION (offline distillation into compact entries) + PROCEDIMENTAL (Golden Principle = transferable design pattern).

benchmarks: BigCodeBench, KGQAGen-10k, Humanity's Last Exam (HLE); also compared on MemRL's ALFWorld/Lifelong Agent Bench setups
fallos_mitigaciones: Flat/unstructured prior memory systems discard procedural structure and lack dual-outcome learning; in flat-text systems, entity changes require finding+rewriting every record or 'stale plans silently degrade retrieval' (S1/S3.2.5). Mitigated by the typed Procedural Knowledge Graph: (a) Entity nodes are versioned via 'supersedes' edges so world-change propagates automatically to all linked Experiences without rewriting procedures (S3.2.5); (b) periodic consolidation archives dominated (same-signature, lower-quality) experiences, merges similar experiences into parameterized templates, and 'flags experiences referencing stale entities for re-validation' (S3.2 Memory Maintenance). Evidence for evidence is content-addressed (SHA-256) with a trust score for provenance tracing.
cita: Banerjee et al. (2026). APEX-EM: Non-Parametric Online Learning for Autonomous Agents via Structured Procedural-Episodic Experience Replay.
notes: S3.2 Procedural Knowledge Graph (PKG): 5 node types (Entity=SEMANTICA world knowledge w/ versioning, Experience=EPISODICA+PROCEDIMENTAL trace, Sub-Task, Operation, TaskTopic) + 10 typed edges (similar_to cosine>0.85, structurally_similar_to LCS>=0.6, supersedes, derived_from, uses_entity...) -> representacion=HIBRIDA (graph+vector). S3.3 Experience = 6 layers incl. Procedure Reflection (ordered steps, budgets, verification checkpoints = literal reusable PLAN template, portable across tasks) -> plan_estado=SI; Evidence Reflection is content-addressed (SHA-256) w/ trust score -> fidelidad_procedencia=SI. S3.2 Memory Maintenance: quality gate s=successful iff q>=theta before commit (ADMISION); EntityResolver dedup via similarity threshold (ADMISION); supersedes-based entity versioning (ACTUALIZACION); periodic consolidation merges similar experiences into templates + archives dominated duplicates (CONSOLIDACION+OLVIDO) + flags stale entities. S3.4.2 Retrieval: semantic search over task embeddings (EMBEDDINGS) + structural-signature LCS matching (enables cross-domain transfer w/ ZERO lexical overlap, e.g. Curry-stats vs Amazon-revenue) + PKG traversal up to 2 hops (GRAFO), composite re-ranked score (RANKING). Results: KGQAGen-10k 89.6% vs 41.3% no-memory (+48.3pp, beats oracle-retrieval 84.9%); BigCodeBench 83.3% from 53.9% (+29.4pp, exceeds MemRL +11.0pp); HLE 48.0% from 25.2% (+22.8pp) where MemRL's embedding-only retrieval gives NO gain (low intra-dataset similarity 0.186) -> structural signature is the key differentiator. Line2927: 'a 2/3 reduction in LLM inference cost per task' -> COSTO/COSTO-TOKENS. Ablation Tables 8/9 toggle components (judge feedback, structural signature, PKG traversal) and measure success rate -> mide_lectura=SI. NEGATIVO sense(a): failed experiences retained w/ Error Registry as explicit negative examples. F extends F_screening (WRITE;NEGATIVO;PROCEDIMENTAL;RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO) with CONSOLIDACION, COSTO, FIDELIDAD (staleness/provenance mechanisms found in full text).

benchmarks: GroupMemBench (own); systems benchmarked: BM25, text-embedding-3-large RAG, GraphRAG, Mem0, MemGPT, A-Mem, HippoRAG, Hindsight
fallos_mitigaciones: Diagnostic finding, NO mitigation proposed by this paper (pure benchmark): current agent memory systems (Mem0, MemGPT, A-Mem, HippoRAG, Hindsight) 'erase the structural and lexical features group memory depends on' (abstract) -- they use user_id as an isolated storage namespace rather than a semantic attribute, and resolve conflicting statements by overwriting older entries rather than preserving coexisting per-speaker beliefs (S2 Related Work), causing collapse on Knowledge-Update (27.1%) and Term-Ambiguity (37.7%) categories; a simple BM25 baseline matches or exceeds most dedicated memory systems (avg 43.22 vs best agent system 46.01).
cita: Yang et al. (2026). GroupMemBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent Memory in Multi-Party Conversations.
notes: Pure benchmark paper (no own memory mechanism) -> mem_tipos/representacion/operaciones/trigger/retrieval=NA; it MEASURES QA accuracy of 8 existing memory/RAG systems on multi-party workplace-channel conversations across 6 adversarial query categories (S3.3.2: Multi-Hop, Knowledge-Update, Term-Ambiguity, User-Implicit, Temporal, Abstention). 'multiagente' here concerns MULTI-USER (multiple human speakers u1..uK sharing memory with one agent), not multiple AI agents sharing memory -- kept NO to match F_screening (no MULTIAGENTE tag) and the facet's multi-AGENT intent; noted as a scope distinction. Knowledge-Update category explicitly 'tests whether the agent tracks dynamic state changes and prefers the latest consensus over outdated facts' = a direct staleness/fidelity probe -> fidelidad_procedencia=SI. Table2: best system (Hindsight) 46.01% avg accuracy; Knowledge-Update lowest at 27.10% (Hindsight) /worse for others; Abstention >75% for most (least dependent on multi-party structure). Table1/S4.1 Eval Metrics: Accuracy (mide_lectura=SI, RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO in F) + Efficiency = ingestion cost USD (Fig4 cost-accuracy tradeoff, App H token-to-USD pricing) -> COSTO-TOKENS/COSTO, + on-disk storage GB (OTRA). NEGATIVO sense(b): sharp systematic collapse of all tested memory systems, BM25 near-matches/beats most. F confirms F_screening (RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO;NEGATIVO) + adds FIDELIDAD (staleness axis) and COSTO (explicit ingestion-cost dimension).

fallos_mitigaciones: Existing self-evolving agents either confine experience to a single task (online reflection, no cross-task reuse) or require costly/ad hoc offline post-processing before reuse is possible (S1). Unsuccessful attempts are explicitly retained as 'warning case' nodes rather than discarded, and linked to their eventual fix via directed 'fixed_by' correction edges, so future retrieval can surface both what failed and how it was corrected (S2.2). Structural ablation (Fig6) shows removing correction edges causes the LARGEST performance drop of any component, confirming the error-repair link is the most load-bearing mitigation.
cita: Jin et al. (2026). EXG: Self-Evolving Agents with Experience Graphs.
notes: S2.2 Experience Graph G=(V,E): Case nodes (golden=successful, warning=failed, EPISODICA) + Task-anchor nodes; typed edges Contain/Similarity(similar_to, semantic)/Correction(fixed_by, error-repair=PROCEDIMENTAL). S2.3-2.4 retrieval: FAISS dense-vector seed search (MiniLM embeddings, K_s=10, EMBEDDINGS) + one-hop expansion over similarity edges (GRAFO) + relevance-propagation reranking combining prompt+failure-aware similarity (RANKING); global cap K_c=30. Graph grows online (case always appended post-execution, no admission gate found -> operaciones=WRITE only) OR is frozen for offline reuse (no updates in eval, S3.2) -- same retrieval/hint pipeline both regimes. Table1: EXG (+ plug-and-play EXG-Reflexion/EXG-SE) beats Reflexion/SE-Agent baselines on pass@1/pass@2 across HumanEval/EvalPlus/MuSiQue/HotpotQA and Qwen3 model sizes; on HumanEval Qwen3-1.7B, EXG improves pass@1 >150% vs Reflexion (matches abstract). S4.3: up to 45.7% fewer LLM calls, up to 30.5% lower LLM inference latency vs baselines (COSTO-TOKENS+LATENCIA); Fig6 structural ablation isolates contribution of similarity vs correction edges (mide_lectura=SI); Table3 hint-type ablation (fixed-by/warning/golden) also measures read-side utility. No multi-agent sharing described for EXG itself (only cited as related work, G-Memory ref [1472]) -> multiagente=NO. NEGATIVO sense(a): warning/failed cases explicitly stored as first-class negative content. F confirms F_screening (NEGATIVO;RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO) + adds COSTO (explicit latency/LLM-call reduction), PROCEDIMENTAL (correction-edge repair knowledge), WRITE.
